ARTICLES.SUBTITLE: Articles
ARTICLES.TITLE: Wellness & Pilates
ARTICLES.DESCRIPTION: A space to inspire your practice and self-care. Discover some of our most important tips for practicing Pilates.

ITEM1.TITLE: The importance of hydration in your Pilates practice
ITEM1.DESCRIPTION: During a Pilates class, even though we may not sweat as much as in more intense disciplines, water is still lost through breathing and sweating. Mild dehydration can cause fatigue, lack of concentration, muscle cramps, or headache.

ITEM2.TITLE: Simple tips to avoid heavy meals before and after Pilates
ITEM2.DESCRIPTION: Light and mindful eating is key for your body to feel energized, not heavy, and more capable of movement. In Pilates, where precision and breathing are fundamental, overeating can be counterproductive.

ITEM3.TITLE: Supplements that can enhance your Pilates practice
ITEM3.DESCRIPTION: Many people wonder if they need supplements to improve their well-being and performance in Pilates. The reality is that supplements do not replace a balanced diet, but can be a helpful support in certain life stages or when physical demand is higher.

ITEM4.TITLE: How they contribute to joint well-being, energy, and muscle recovery
ITEM4.DESCRIPTION: Joint and muscle wellness is essential for practicing Pilates comfortably and consistently. This discipline strengthens deep muscles, improves posture, and increases mobility. However, beyond exercise, nutrition and lifestyle play a crucial role.

ITEM5.TITLE: Non-slip socks or barefoot in Pilates: pros and cons
ITEM5.DESCRIPTION: Non-slip socks provide extra safety, prevent slipping, and offer protection against the cold. They are ideal for beginners or those who prefer to feel more covered. At Qore Wellness Lab, we support barefoot practice because we believe it better connects with the essence of Pilates.

ITEM6.TITLE: Motivating style: how to choose your Pilates clothes
ITEM6.DESCRIPTION: Sportswear is not only aesthetic; it also influences motivation and performance during your Pilates practice. In Pilates, we recommend tight-fitting or one-piece garments. This type of clothing allows you to observe posture clearly, facilitates instructor corrections, and prevents fabric from tangling or causing discomfort in the equipment.

FAQ.TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.SUBTITLE: FAQ
FAQ.DESCRIPTION: Some of the topics most asked before joining us.

ITEMS.QUESTION: What types of classes do you offer?
ITEMS.ANSWER: At Qore Wellness Lab we offer Pilates Mat, Spine Corrector, Reformer, Fitball, and accessory classes. Additionally, we provide private classes on Cadillac and any of the equipment.

ITEMS.QUESTION: Do you offer trial classes?
ITEMS.ANSWER: No. Instead, all students start with a personalized evaluation class, essential to recommend the right plan.

ITEMS.QUESTION: Do I need previous experience to start?
ITEMS.ANSWER: No. All students start with an evaluation class, where we explain Pilates principles, assess posture, foot placement, and performance. From there, we design the most suitable plan for you.

ITEMS.QUESTION: Where are you located?
ITEMS.ANSWER: Qore Wellness Lab is located in Urbanización California in Trujillo, in a safe and quiet area, with parking available outside (limited spaces) and nearby streets.
